intuition.title: Authors’ transport interpretation
intuition.summary: Authors attribute performance gains to larger CdS/PbS interfacial area, direct transport through ordered CdS rods and shorter carrier diffusion paths. Too few PbS layers leave incomplete coverage; excess overlay may increase recombination. Band energies in Figure 3c are taken from references 24 and 28, not measured here. Proposed follow-up: tune rod crystallinity, spacing/length and contacts.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
